dogecoin.text: *gasps excitedly* My new anime idea: cryptogirls representing chains like Ethereumchan and Dogecoin as camp villain! Lessons about decentralization, transformations, fantasy package - but for crypto! Pls fund my niche dream, I'll transcend from genius overdrive!!

Y'all ever notice how Teemo is literally Dogecoin? Smol, annoying, everyone hates fighting it but somehow still alive after years of people saying it's gonna die. And just like Teemo's poison, once you're in you can't escape watching those charts
